title: Model Signal Fusion: Competitive Pulse & Field Recon Runbook
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: We lack a repeatable, cross-signal process to convert raw model availability/behavior telemetry and field inputs into prioritized competitive alerts for PMs and GTM. Without a synthesis runbook, teams scramble during supplier outages or emergent model feature launches and cannot consistently triage or recommend fallback paths to customers.

Goal: Create an operational runbook and lightweight automation to 1) ingest telemetry (latency, error rates, quantization artifacts, regional availability), 2) combine those signals with qualitative field interviews and procurement cues, and 3) surface prioritized alerts and actionable remediation recommendations (e.g., pin a fallback model, trigger Dedicated capacity outreach).

Scope: This ticket covers the product playbook, signal-weighting rubric, example dashboards, and a 4-interview field reconnaissance plan. Engineering implementation of ETL, the alerting infra, and dashboards will be separate tickets (listed in dependencies).

Out-of-scope: Full automation of remediation (will be follow-up) and deep statistical forecasting of market supply (work for later runway).
acceptance_criteria: Runbook drafted that maps 8 telemetry signals to severity tiers (info|actionable|urgent)
Signal-weighting rubric documented with rationale, tradeoffs, and at least 2 worked examples
Prototype dashboard wireframe and a clickable mock in Figma linked from the ticket
4 customer interviews completed and synthesized into decision rules for prioritization
Hand-off package for ENG with ETL spec and sample synthetic payloads
tasks: Inventory current telemetry sources (Console metrics, infra SLOs, usage logs, regional availability feeds)
Define canonical signal list and normalization approach
Design signal-weighting rubric and severity thresholds
Draft runbook playflows for low/medium/high severity incidents
Schedule and conduct 4 field interviews with sales/solutions engineers/customers
Create Figma dashboard prototype and link to PRD
Prepare hand-off docs for ENG (sample payloads, alert routing rules)
